music.theAuthorHasntAddedAny: The author hasn't added any tracks yet.
music.uploadMp3OggWavFiles: Upload MP3/Ogg/WAV files that you created or are licensed to use (16 MB per track, 100 MB per site). For Spotify tracks/albums/playlists and YouTube videos, choose "Platform player"; visitors use the official platform player after pressing Load. For other platforms, choose "External link". The system never downloads or re-hosts platform audio.
music.addOneFirstThenEnter: Add one first, then enter audio or a work link you have the right to use.
music.playsHereUploadAnAudio: Plays here: upload an audio file you have the right to use.
music.playsHerePasteTheHttps: Plays here: paste the HTTPS URL of the audio file itself (.mp3/.ogg/.wav), not a web page such as YouTube or Spotify.
music.opensExternallyVisitorsClickOpen: Opens externally: visitors click "Open original link" to go to the original site; it won't play here.
music.platformPlayerAfterVisitorsPress: Platform player: after visitors press Load, the official Spotify/YouTube player is used inside Retro.
music.theFileIsStoredIn: The file is stored in your private draft; a public version is created only when you publish.
music.afterYouChooseAFile: After you choose a file, the upload result appears here.
music.youCanSwitchThisTo: You can switch this to the {{platformLabel}} platform player, or keep it as an external link. The URL you pasted is kept as is.
music.thisUrlDoesntLookLike: This URL doesn't look like an audio file (.mp3/.ogg/.wav). If it's a web page or platform link, use "External link" instead.
music.pasteASpotifyTrackAlbum: Paste a Spotify track/album/playlist or YouTube video URL.
music.onlySpotifyAndYoutubeUrls: Only Spotify and YouTube URLs are supported right now; for other sites use "External link". It is saved as an external link for now.
music.changeToExternalLinkKeep: Change to external link (keep the URL)
music.visitorsWillSeeOpenOriginal: Visitors will see "Open original link"; it won't pretend it can play here.
music.eGMyOwnOriginal: e.g. My own original work / used with the author's permission
music.webLinkNote: This track's source is a {{platform}} web page link, not an audio file, so it can't be played here. Use "Open original link".
music.thisIsWebLink: This is a {{platform}} web page link, not an audio file, so it can't be played here.
music.canEmbed: This is a {{platform}} {{resource}}; visitors can load the official player inside Retro (visitors must press Load).
music.savedAsExternal: It is saved as an external link for now.
music.recognized: Recognized: {{platform}} {{resource}} ({{id}}). The original URL was kept.
music.slowNotice: The {{label}} player hasn't responded yet. If it never appears, use "Open on {{label}}".

source.label: Paste a link or upload a file
source.placeholder: Paste a YouTube, Spotify or audio-file URL
source.auto: The source is recognised automatically — you don’t need to choose a type first.
source.recognizedEmbed: Recognised as {{platform}} {{resource}}: visitors press play and use the official {{platform}} player right on the page.
source.recognizedAudio: Recognised as an audio file URL: visitors can play it right on the page.
source.recognizedVideoFile: This is a video file URL. Video files can’t be played inside the page yet, so it is saved as an external link that opens in a new tab.
source.recognizedPage: This is an ordinary web page. A web page can’t be played as audio, so it is saved as an external link that opens the original page in a new tab.
source.reasonShortLink: This is a {{platform}} short link. Paste the full URL (an open.spotify.com or youtube.com link) to play it in the page; for now it is saved as an external link.
source.reasonUnsupportedResource: This {{platform}} link isn’t a track, album, playlist or video, so it can’t be embedded; it is saved as an external link to the original site.
source.reasonUnsupportedPlatform: {{platform}} can’t be played inside the page yet; it is saved as an external link to the original site.
source.invalid: Paste a full URL that starts with https://.
source.invalidCredentials: The URL can’t contain a username or password.
source.invalidPort: The URL can’t specify a port.
source.invalidTooLong: The URL is too long (2048 characters at most).
source.useExternal: Use an external link instead (opens the original site)
source.uploaded: Using the uploaded audio file; visitors can play it right on the page. Pasting a link replaces it.
source.playerNote: The player isn’t loaded until a visitor presses play.
source.wasAudioPlatform: This is a {{platform}} web page that was saved as an audio file, so it can’t play. Switch to the in-page player.
source.canEmbed: This link can be played in the page with the official {{platform}} player.
source.savedAudioNotAudio: This URL isn’t an audio file, so it can’t be played as audio. Save it as an external link instead.

providerPlayer.nothingConnectsToUntilYou: Nothing connects to {{v1}} until you press "Load", and no data is sent to {{label}} before then.
providerPlayer.thisSourcesIdIsNo: This source's ID is no longer valid, so a player can't be created.
providerPlayer.whetherItPlaysInFull: Whether it plays in full depends on your Spotify account, region and browser cookie settings. When not signed in, you may only get a preview clip.
providerPlayer.someVideosDontAllowEmbedded: Some videos don't allow embedded playback. If that happens, use "Open on YouTube" instead.

audioCoordinator.theAudioCouldntBeLoaded: The audio couldn't be loaded. Check the URL, permissions or cross-site restrictions.
audioCoordinator.audioMustUseAValid: Audio must use a valid HTTPS direct URL or an authorized uploaded file.
audioCoordinator.audioLoadingTimedOutOpen: Audio loading timed out. Open the original link to check whether the source is still available.
audioCoordinator.theBrowserCouldntPlayThis: The browser couldn't play this audio. Try again or open the original link.
audioCoordinator.audioLoadingTimedOutRetry: Audio loading timed out. Retry or check the file's usage rights.
audioCoordinator.theAudioCouldntBeLoaded2: The audio couldn't be loaded. Check the file's usage rights and retry.

sourceInsight.pasteTheFullUrlShort: Paste the full {{label}} URL; short links can't be identified safely.
sourceInsight.spotifyEmbedsCurrentlySupportTrack: Spotify embeds currently support track, album and playlist URLs.
sourceInsight.youtubeEmbedsCurrentlySupportSingle: YouTube embeds currently support single video and playlist URLs.
sourceInsight.embedsArentSupportedYetUse: {{label}} embeds aren't supported yet. Use "External link" instead.
sourceInsight.thisIsAWebPage: This is a {{platformLabel}} web page link, not an audio file, so the browser can't play it directly. Change the source to "External link" or "Platform player".
sourceInsight.thisUrlDoesntLookLike: {{rawMessage}} This URL doesn't look like an audio file (.mp3, .ogg, .wav…).
sourceInsight.theFileMayHaveBeen: {{rawMessage}} The file may have been removed, the site may not allow use elsewhere, or the format may not be supported.

m2.heading: Playback help
m2.guidance: If this {{label}} player does not play, Retro cannot confirm the cause. Access to the content, browser privacy settings or the network may affect playback. Retry, or open the original site to check availability.

m3.recognizedVideo: Video file URL detected: visitors can load it here. The extension is a hint; playback depends on the actual file and browser.
m3.externalFile: This file is saved as an external link. Keep that choice, or choose the in-page player below.
m3.cannotPlay: The video could not be played
m3.failure: The video could not be loaded or played. The file may be unavailable, the server may restrict playback, or this browser may not support its format or codecs. Retry or open the original link.
m3.formatNote: Direct HTTPS .mp4, .webm, .m4v, .mov and .ogv files only. Browser format and codec support varies; webpages are opened externally.
